annotation.summary: ToolModel is the MCP tool registry. ToolModel.slugifyName builds the full tool identifier written to tools.name; discovery and clone reconciliation re-derive that identifier for matching, while wire/proxy paths parse stored names through unslugifyName and parseFullToolName when speaking upstream.

sideEffects.description: Creates, updates, and reconciles rows in tools and related assignment/policy tables.

risks.text: slugifyName and unslugifyName are the stored-identity codec for tools.name: persisted rows, client-addressed names, clone reconciliation, prefix stripping, and the parseFullToolName inverse all depend on the same codec boundary. Adding name-policy behavior to this codec couples that policy to stored and wire identities.

Editing the wire consumers (resolveActualToolName / mcp-client name-resolution, mcp-server-gateway.utils, mcp-server-proxy) to round-trip disambiguated names upstream — e.g. storing a raw name in meta and preferring it, or rekeying the name-resolution map — changes the external serving/matching contract; these consumers are frozen alongside the codec.

invariants: tools.name stores the full slug from catalog/server name plus raw MCP tool name; existing rows, policies, assignments, clone reconciliation, and proxy-discovered adoption match by that stored name.
The stored slug is externally observable: gateway/proxy list/call paths translate through unslugifyName when speaking to upstream/raw MCP names.
unslugifyName and mcp-client prefix stripping rely on the same '__' separator convention, including the slugifyName(prefix, '') prefix form.

slugifyName's output for a given server/tool pair is consumed as stored identity by persisted data, wire addressing, clone reconciliation, and the inverse parser; this module treats that pairwise codec as a boundary between raw MCP names and stored tool identity.

slugifyName is a per-tool-pair transform: it receives one server name and one raw tool name, with no visibility into sibling tools, existing tool rows, assignments, policies, or discovery batch order; making identifiers distinct across a server's tools is therefore a property of the layer that holds them together, not of this transform.

A tool whose name strips to empty yields the bare server__; when it is the only such tool on its server, that is a unique, addressable stored identifier. A per-tool-pair transform cannot distinguish that lone tool from several tools colliding on server__, so resolving the degenerate case in the codec changes the lone tool's working identifier. Distinguishing a lone bare-prefix tool from colliding ones requires seeing a server's tools as a set, the same write layer any collision needs, not this transform.

The wire consumers (mcp-client name-resolution, gateway serving, proxy matching) resolve a stored tools.name to its upstream tool by matching against the server's live tool list; how an already-addressable tool resolves is an external-client serving/matching contract that stays unchanged. Colliding and degenerate tools are already unresolvable upstream, so a disambiguated slug that does not round-trip to a raw upstream name is not a defect this task repairs; the wire is not extended to route it.
annotation.integrationPoints: mod:@backend/src/database/schemas/tool; mod:@archestra/shared/utils (parseFullToolName only, not the whole utility module); mod:@backend/src/routes/mcp-server-gateway.utils; mod:@backend/src/routes/mcp-server-proxy; mod:@backend/src/clients/mcp-client; mod:@backend/src/routes/mcp-server; mod:@backend/src/archestra-mcp-server/mcp-servers; mod:@backend/src/services/mcp-reinstall; mod:@backend/src/services/apps/app-mcp-backing

dataFlow.storedIdentity: raw catalog/server name plus raw MCP tool name -> ToolModel.slugifyName -> tools.name; discovery, reinstall, and clone reconciliation later re-derive the same string to match existing rows.
dataFlow.wireInverse: stored tools.name -> gateway/proxy list/call paths -> ToolModel.unslugifyName -> parseFullToolName -> upstream/raw MCP tool name.
